title: Hexenwasser Söll Hohe Salve
highlights: Austria's longest barefoot trail featuring more than 60 nature activity stations
Interactive water play areas with Kneipp basins, water wheels, and balance ponds
Apiary and bee house with see-through educational hives
Historic Witch's Kitchen and herb garden located on Hohe Salve
kurzbeschreibung: The Hexenwasser in Söll on the Hohe Salve is an award-winning alpine adventure world focusing on water, nature, and the senses.
beschreibung:
Playful Nature Experience for the Senses

The Hexenwasser at the middle station of the Bergbahn Söll on the Hohe Salve has been delighting families and nature lovers for many years. Under the motto 'Marvel, Grasp, and Understand', more than 60 stations encourage visitors to feel, listen, and discover natural phenomena.

Austria's Longest Barefoot Trail and Bee Haven

On Austria's longest barefoot trail, visitors feel grass, stones, babbling brooks, and bark mulch beneath their feet. Inside the bee house, activity hums and buzzes, while in the rustic witch's kitchen, the witches keep ancient lore of medicinal herbs and natural forces alive.
